classification.difficultyReason: Pair the segments belonging to each intersecting chord, equate their products and solve a one-step linear equation.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.sourceRegion: Top row, right column, part vv
spec.description: An unshaded circle with two intersecting chords. The descending chord has segments labelled 6 cm and x; the rising chord has segments labelled 8 cm and 3 cm. Decorative source hues are replaced by ordinary black geometry.
spec.mathematics: The two products of chord intercepts are equal: 6x = 8 × 3. No centre, intersection label or additional marks are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given lengths and unknown x appear in the question diagram; the supplied 4 cm answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The products of the intercepts of intersecting chords are equal.
$$\begin{align*}8x&=5\times12\\8x&=60\\x&=7.5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
